# `indent_size`

Columns per indent level.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `4`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```editorconfig
indent_size = <value>
```
